description: 2.0 renderer parity experiment (Workbench D-041): the same run as renderer_parity_menu_smoke with --debug-renderer-constant-noise, which gives the combiner's noise term frame count 0 and noise scale 0 in both backends, so its random() returns exactly 0 (noise input 0.5; the dithered alpha test keeps only opaque texels). Differences that remain do not come from the noise hash. 2.0 renderer phase 2a (D5): with --renderer-parity the classic GL renderer presents and the bgfx backend renders the same frames offscreen from the same fast3d, scene-renderer and ImGui commands. Each screenshot event compares the two finished frames pixel for pixel (port/fast3d/gfx_parity.cpp): <shot> is the GL frame, <shot>.bgfx.bmp the bgfx frame, <shot>.diff.bmp the difference (x64) and <shot>.parity.json the counts. Front-end menu: Agent Select, ImGui over the 3D Carrington Institute background with the character preview. The wait is core_boot_ready plus time, not agent_select_ready: that condition needs keyboard focus, which a runner in the background does not get; for the same reason the Main Menu (a keypress away) is not captured.

input_sequence.comment: Agent Select is up about 20 s after boot completes (the menu background stage loads first).

required_lines: renderer: --debug-renderer-constant-noise: combiner noise held at 0.5 in every backend
